parameters.content:
## Setup (v12 - 100% free)
**Credentials (only these 3):**
1. `Gemini API Key` - type *Header Auth*. Name: `x-goog-api-key`  Value: your key from aistudio.google.com (free)
2. Gmail account - OAuth2 (free, already connected)
3. Google Sheets account - OAuth2 (free, already connected)

No key needed: OpenStreetMap Overpass (lead source), dns.google (email MX check).

**Sheet 'Leads' headers (row 1):** Date Added, Business Name, Niche, City, Address, Phone, Website, Instagram, Facebook, Email, Email Source, Active Signal, Place ID, Subject, Site Detail, Status, Last Contacted, Follow-ups Sent, Language

**Settings1:** fill postalAddress (needed for US CAN-SPAM). Fill testEmail for a safe test run, empty it for real sending.
Model name is in Settings1/Settings (Follow-up)1 (`model`). If Gemini says model not found, pick another Flash model from AI Studio.
